title: American agriculturist
description:
v. 37 cm
"The American agriculturist has absorbed more than thirty agricultural journals, including Genesee farmer, Alabama farmer, American farmer's magazine, Connecticut homestead, Farm journal and progressive farmer and others."
Issues for July-Sept. 3, 1927, called v. 120, no. 1-10; Sept. 10-Dec. 31, 1927, called v. 121, no. 11-26; Jan. 7-June 30, 1928, called v. 122, no. 1-25; July-Dec. 1928, called v. 122, no. 1-26
United with Rural New Yorker to form American agriculturalist and the rural New Yorker with vol. 161 no. 12, Dec. 1964
